name: Binary Search
description:
Implement Binary Search on a sorted integer slice.

Given a sorted slice `arr` and a target integer `target`, return the 0-based index of `target` if it exists in `arr`. If the target is not present, return -1.

Your solution must run in logarithmic time.
hints: Maintain two pointers `low` and `high` marking the active search boundary (initially 0 and len(arr)-1).
Calculate the middle index with `mid := low + (high-low)/2` to avoid integer overflow.
If arr[mid] == target, return mid. If arr[mid] < target, narrow to the right half (low = mid + 1). Otherwise, narrow to the left half (high = mid - 1). Loop while low <= high.
